title: Resolve event expiry and crawl eligibility against the host timezone
detail: Source-confirmed mismatch requiring scoped follow-up: lib/events/datetime.ts stores host wall-clock parts as UTC-naive values, but eventHasEnded compares those values directly with now. lib/discover.ts uses it for public-event expiry and lib/events/series-seo.ts for sitemap eligibility, without passing time_zone. For an America/Los_Angeles event ending 2026-06-26T19:00:00Z in storage, at 2026-06-27T00:00:00Z the helper reports ended although host time is only 17:00. The canonical lib/time/zone.ts eventInstant seam interprets the wall-clock correctly. Trace public RPC/listing filters and zone enrichment before repairing so page, metadata and sitemap agree without adding expensive imports across public build roots. Prior LIVE-199 fixed JSON-LD zone enrichment, not this expiry seam. No production event rows were inspected and no live impact was asserted.

verify.evidence: Open: prove public page index eligibility and sitemap retention for a Pacific 19:00 stored wall-clock end at 17:00 host time, then removal after its true instant; cover London DST, missing-zone fallback and explicit cancellation. Require route/RPC zone plumbing evidence rather than a helper-only mock.
